Everyone in the study will receive the tomato juice drink, and both participants and researchers will know what is being taken. The investigators expect the drink will be well tolerated, may lower inflammation, and may improve participant-reported symptoms and quality of life.

docs.summary: This study is testing a medicine called surlorian in adults who have a genetic muscle condition known as autosomal dominant RYR1-related myopathy (RYR1-RM). The goal is to find out whether surlorian improves muscle weakness, and whether it is safe and well tolerated.

docs.summary: Glucagon-like peptide (GLP1) drugs have quickly become a standard treatment for the adults with obesity. These drugs target the appetite control center of the brain, which clows the rate of stomach emptying, and makes a person feel full. The researchers are exploring this response in children. This study is being conducted to better understand how two food carbohydrates affect the appetite control center of the brain. The investigators want to see if a special carbohydrate powder that is mixed with 1 cup of water twice a day will appetite.

docs.title: AV-1959R Vaccine in Individuals With Preclinical Alzheimer's Disease
docs.summary: This Phase 2 study will evaluate the safety, tolerability, immunogenicity, and amyloid-lowering effect of AV-1959R in cognitively unimpaired adults with preclinical Alzheimer's disease. Approximately 160 participants will be randomized to receive AV-1959R or placebo and will be followed for 78 weeks. The study will assess safety, immune responses, brain amyloid, and Alzheimer's disease-related biomarkers.

docs.title: Effect of Trimetazidine on Coronary Flow in Transthyretin Cardiac Amyloidosis
docs.summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if trimetazidine can improve blood flow in the heart in adults with transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTR-CM). ATTR-CM is a condition in which an abnormal protein builds up in the heart and can make it harder for the heart to work normally.

The main question this study aims to answer is:

Does trimetazidine improve the heart's ability to increase its blood flow when more blood is needed?

The study will also look at whether treatment is linked to changes in walking ability, heart-related blood tests, heart function, and quality of life.

docs.summary: A study of ALV-100 to assess efficacy, safety and tolerability among participants with overweight or obesity who have previously achieved a body weight reduction of ≥10% while treated with incretin-based therapies.

docs.title: A Clinical Study of Sotatercept (MK-7962) in People With Combined Postcapillary and Precapillary Pulmonary Hypertension and Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction (MK-7962-041)
docs.summary: Researchers are looking for other ways to treat people with combined postcapillary and precapillary pulmonary hypertension (CpcPH). This trial focuses on CpcPH that is related to heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). The goal of the study is to learn if participants who receive sotatercept live longer without their CpcPH-HFpEF getting worse than those who receive placebo.

docs.summary: Family caregivers of people living with dementia are at high risk of poor health when caregiving for their loved one. docs.summary:

docs.summary:

docs.summary: This Phase 1b/2, open-label, multicenter, single-arm study evaluates the safety and efficacy of ivonescimab in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced malignant pleural mesothelioma. Phase 1b evaluates the candidate recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D), followed by Phase 2 evaluation at the confirmed RP2D.

docs.title: A Study to Investigate the Effect of LY4086940 Versus Placebo in Participants With Obesity or Overweight and Without Type 2 Diabetes
docs.summary:
The purpose of this study, performed under the master protocol W8M-MC- CWMM (NCT06143956), is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of LY4086940 compared with placebo in participants without type 2 diabetes who have obesity or who have overweight with a weight-related health condition.

Participation in the study will last about 58 weeks.

docs.title: A Study of PLS240 in Pediatric Participants With Secondary Hyperparathyroidism and Chronic Kidney Disease on Hemodialysis
docs.summary:
Approximately 56 participants who are 1 month old to 17 years old will be enrolled in this study. The total duration for this study will be 38 weeks (or up to 42 weeks when participants require a washout period due to prior exposure to prohibited medications) and includes the following periods:

* Active screening period of 6 weeks (or, up to 10 weeks for participants requiring a washout period).
* Treatment period of 28 weeks consisting of a 19-week dose titration period and 9-week stable dose period.
* Safety follow-up period of 4 weeks.

docs.title: Lean Mass Changes With Semaglutide in Adults With Type 1 Diabetes and Overweight/Obesity.

docs.summary:
The goal of this 24 week double-blinded, randomized, parallel controlled clinical trial is to learn how semaglutide affects body composition in adults with type 1 diabetes and overweight/obesity.

The main question to answer is:

What effect does Semaglutide have on body composition in adults with type 1 diabetes and overweight/obesity compared to a placebo?

Around 40 participants will:

* Be randomly assigned to receive semaglutide or a placebo.
* Self-administer the treatment drug once per week for 24 weeks.
* Complete a series of tests, measurements and questionnaires throughout the study

docs.title: Reducing Arterial Inflammation Using Eplerenone and Statins in HIV
docs.summary: HIV has transitioned to a chronic disease in which well-treated persons remain at higher risk for heart disease when compared to the general population. Statin medications have been shown to reduce the number of events related to heart disease, but there are still individuals who will have complications from heart disease despite statin use. This study is being conducted to determine whether adding on another medication to statins called eplerenone, which has been shown to reduce inflammation in the heart vasculature among persons with HIV, can further decrease the risk of heart disease in HIV

docs.summary:

It is characterized by aggressive and rapid growth and early spread to distant sites. Extensive stage-small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) includes cases where disease has spread beyond one side of the chest. This study will evaluate the safety and efficacy of ABBV-706 in combination with atezolizumab and alveltamig in previously untreated ES-SCLC.

docs.summary: This is a randomized, multicenter, phase III clinical study to compare the efficacy and safety of perioperative treatment with adebrelimab plus platinum-based chemotherapy versus adebrelimab adjuvant therapy in patients with resectable stage II-IIIB non-small-cell lung cancer(NSCLC).

docs.title: Efficacy And Safety of Olatorepatide in Adults With Overweight or Obesity Without Diabetes
docs.summary:
This study will test olatorepatide (study drug) to determine whether it can help treat overweight or obesity.

In this study we will test how safe and how well olatorepatide works compared to placebo in people who are overweight or obese but do not have diabetes.

The study is looking at:

* How well the study drug works
* How the body and blood and urine biomarkers change after taking the study drug, which can help researchers understand why the study drug may work better in some people than in others
